name: Hotel Eden
insider_take: Perched atop Rome's Ludovisi Hill, Hotel Eden offers the Eternal City's most coveted rooftop dining experience with panoramic views that sweep from St. Peter's Dome to Villa Borghese.
whats_special: This legendary Dorchester Collection property has been Rome's social epicenter since 1889, hosting everyone from Hemingway to Fellini. The hotel's La Terrazza restaurant boasts a Michelin star and arguably the most Instagram-worthy sunset views in all of Rome, sitting just steps from the Spanish Steps and Via Veneto's glamorous boutiques.
pro_tip: Book dinner at La Terrazza for golden hour (around 7 PM in summer) to catch the sun setting behind St. Peter's Basilica – reservations are essential and the terrace fills up quickly with Rome's elite crowd.
dont_miss: The hotel's legendary martini service on the rooftop terrace, featuring house-infused spirits and garnishes made from herbs grown in their private garden. Also, explore the nearby Villa Borghese gardens at dawn for a peaceful escape before the city awakens, then return for Eden's famous Roman breakfast on the terrace.
pros: Panoramic rooftop terrace with stunning views of Rome's skyline
Michelin-starred Il Giardino restaurant with exceptional cuisine
Prime location at the top of the Spanish Steps
Impeccable service and attention to detail
cons: Historic building may have smaller room sizes
